Main process of DSB formation and repair

Main process of DSB formation and repair. The DSB repair pathway includes HR (A), SSA (B), and NHEJ repair, in which NHEJ includes alt-NHEJ (C) and c-NHEJ (D) repair. The genes involved in each step are shown in the box. Mutant genes found in patients with NOA are marked in blue, and mutant genes that are not currently evidenced are marked in red
